keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «어떤 동물은 초능력처럼 보이는 감각을 가졌다(주제)» 와 «동물의 감각은 저마다 사는 방식에 꼭 알맞다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (some animals have senses that seem like superpowers) and the conclusion (every animal’s senses are perfectly suited to the way it lives). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Dogs, bats, birds, snakes, and the platypus
Each sense fits the way the animal lives

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why can trained dogs find lost people in snow or fallen buildings?
qs.qko: 훈련받은 개는 왜 눈 속이나 무너진 건물에서 사람을 찾아낼 수 있나요?
opts: Because their sense of smell is thousands of times better than ours
Because they can see in complete darkness
Because they can sense heat like pythons
evs: Dogs, for example, have a sense of smell that is thousands of times better than ours.
Bats can fly and catch tiny insects in complete darkness by using sound.
Snakes such as pythons can sense heat, so they can find warm animals in the dark.
Scientists study these senses to design new technology, such as sonar and better sensors.
why: 개의 후각은 사람보다 수천 배나 뛰어나요. «That is why» 는 바로 앞 문장에 그 이유가 있다는 신호예요.
Dogs have a sense of smell thousands of times better than ours. «That is why» tells you the reason is in the sentence before.

qs.q: In “This skill is called echolocation,” what does “echolocation” mean?
qs.qko: «This skill is called echolocation» 에서 «echolocation» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: finding things by making sounds and listening for echoes
finding things by smelling the air
finding things by sensing their heat
evs: They make high-pitched calls and listen for the echoes that bounce back.
Dogs, for example, have a sense of smell that is thousands of times better than ours.
Snakes such as pythons can sense heat, so they can find warm animals in the dark.
It can detect the tiny electric signals made by the muscles of its prey.
why: 바로 앞 문장에서 박쥐는 높은 소리를 내고 되돌아오는 메아리를 듣는다고 했어요. «This skill» 은 바로 그 방법을 가리켜요.
The sentence before says bats make high-pitched calls and listen for the echoes that bounce back. «This skill» means that way of finding things.

qs.q: How can the platypus hunt underwater with its eyes, ears, and nose closed?
qs.qko: 오리너구리는 눈, 귀, 코를 닫고도 물속에서 어떻게 사냥할 수 있나요?
opts: It uses its bill to sense the tiny electric signals made by its prey’s muscles
It listens for echoes like a bat
It follows smells in the water like a dog
evs: It can detect the tiny electric signals made by the muscles of its prey.
It closes its eyes, ears, and nose underwater and hunts with its bill alone.
They make high-pitched calls and listen for the echoes that bounce back.
Many birds can sense Earth's magnetic field, which helps them travel thousands of kilometers.
why: 오리너구리는 먹잇감의 근육이 만드는 아주 약한 전기 신호를 감지할 수 있고, 물속에서는 부리 하나만으로 사냥해요. 두 문장을 이으면 부리로 전기 신호를 느낀다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
The platypus can detect tiny electric signals from its prey’s muscles, and it hunts with its bill alone. Together, these show it senses the signals with its bill.

ends: How do sharks sense tiny electric signals in the water?
상어는 물속의 아주 약한 전기 신호를 어떻게 느낄까?
How does sonar on a ship work like a bat?
배의 음파 탐지기는 어떻게 박쥐처럼 작동할까?

write.src: “I want to <u>study animal senses</u> because <u>they can help us design new technology</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because bats can fly in the dark)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because bats can fly in the dark)
